1.Title: The Veiled Earl
1.Content: During the banquet, Earl Leofric may not have been in his Manor.

2.Title: Dispute
2.Content: Thane seemingly had a dispute with the Prince before the dance.

3.Title: Strange Noises
3.Content: During the dance, strange noises were heard coming from underground, but nothing else was out of the ordinary.

4.Title: Important Apparel
4.Content: Hendrik said that this Formal Apparel has significant meaning to those that are concerned about the Hypogean War, so it is highly valued.

5.Title: Dance Arrangements
5.Content: According to Hendrik, the Earl was invited to the dance, but his presence was not seen. It bothered him a little.

6.Title: Desert Cave
6.Content: A man-made cave is located in the desert outside of the city. The cave is narrow, meaning regularly-sized folk are unable to enter it.

7.Title: Patrol
7.Content: The guard temporarily stepped away from the room where the Formal Apparel was being kept. When he left, he saw Thane patrolling nearby.

8.Title: Suspicious Sounds
8.Content: The guard left his post because he heard a quiet rustling sound, it as if it might have been a Durri.

9.Title: The Departing Carriage
9.Content: Only the Earl's carriage left the city during the banquet, and Thane followed it out of town.

10.Title: Loose Tiles
10.Content: Certain tiles on the dance floor were previously raised, beneath it is a hidden subterranean tunnel. Grains of sand and red fur can be seen at the tunnel entrance.

11.Title: Reasons to Follow
11.Content: Estrilda informed Thane that she had seen a suspicious figure enter the Earl's carriage, thus she followed it.

12.Title: Carriage Inside the Manor
12.Content: Estrilda saw the Earl's carriage stop within the Manor grounds.

13.Title: Hidden Figure
13.Content: Thane witnessed a figure hiding beneath the carriage. When he intercepted, there was nobody to be seen.

14.Title: A Delivery of Books
14.Content: Thane reported the Earl's carriage was carrying a pile of books, and his butler. Nothing was out of the ordinary.

15.Title: Muddy Tracks
15.Content: Muddy wheel tracks. A horse-drawn carriage had been through here, but had not stopped.

16.Title: Durri Prints
16.Content: Durri foot prints, but not many. It looks as if they jumped off the carriage.

17.Title: Hidden Cave
17.Content: A distant cave, concealed by a pile of rocks. It seems somebody is hiding inside.

18.Title: Robbery Plans
18.Content: Walker heard that the Formal Apparel would be on display. It's said to be quite valuable. With Kren's help, he plans on getting rich.

19.Title: Ruined Plans
19.Content: When Kren didn't show, Walker figured he must have taken the apparel for himself.

20.Title: Broken Box
20.Content: Judging by the scratches left in the wood, it looks like it was moved by someone.

21.Title: Cabin Entrance
21.Content: The cabin entrance of the boat cabin has been broken, forming a narrow passage in it. When listening carefully, quiet cursing can be heard coming from within.

22.Title: Room Without Clothes
22.Content: When Kren's family finished digging the tunnel, they realized the room was empty. They may have dug into the wrong room.

23.Title: Decorated Undercarriage
23.Content: The underside of the Earl's carriage is finely decorated. It feels extremely high quality to the touch. It's a shame the area is not well-lit, it's hard to make out the decorative patterns.

24.Title: Immersive Reading
24.Content: The Earl seemed to show more interest in a limited edition collection of books that had come into his possession than the dance. During the day of the dance, he was engrossed in his books, thus, lost track of time.

25.Title: Borrowed Books
25.Content: Earl Leofric said that the carriage departed to transport books back to the manor.

26.Title: Undercarriage Cufflink
26.Content: A cufflink has gotten stuck in a gap on the underside of the carriage.

27.Content: A painting of the Prince. It looks nothing like his actual self.

28.Content: A bloodied piece of paper! (Smells paper), whoops, actually, it's only red wine.

29.Content: A note stuck to the carpet. The words on it are hard to discern.

30.Content: A knocked-over wine glass. It looks as if the day of the dance was quite a chaotic one.

31.Content: Memoirs Of The Hypogean War - The dance is, after all, a remembrance of the war. It is not surprising that this book would be here on a day like this.

32.Content: A bunch of brightly colored mushrooms. Eating one will definitely lead to a poisonous demise.

33.Content: Thick woods. Those boulders at the back of the woods look to be a suitable place for concealing oneself.

34.Content: Gold and silver jewelry are scattered all over the floor. It most definitely looks to be a "Pirate Ship".

35.Content: The ship's hull is somewhat damaged. It's not been out at sea for some years.

36.Content: A tiny crown. It looks very valuable.

37.Content: A sharp sword stuck in the ship's deck. You try to pull it free, but are unable to do so.
